{{VolumePrevNext| number=7 | series=Magical Pokémon Journey | colorscheme=Johto}} {{VolumeInfobox | image=Magical Pokémon Journey VIZ volume 7.png | number=7 | series=Magical Pokémon Journey | chapters=[[PPP37]] - [[PPP43]] | chapter=Johto }} '''Volume 7: From the Heart''' is the seventh of ten volumes of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. ==Blurb== '''IN THIS VOLUME…'''
Bonus stories and features never before printed in English!
A mysterious beauty appears and threatens to take Gramps away from his enemies—er, friends—if he doesn't invent something that actually works! * Clefairy and Pikachu make friends and enemies under the sea…but it's hard to tell which is which! * Eevee and Little Lu go on their first date, and everything goes smoothly and according to plan…NOT! * Hazel and Coconut must rescue Almond when he falls into a mysterious deep sleep and can't wake up. * Sandy and Raichu return for a guest appearance. * PLUS, more stories starring Qwilfish, a bed of Shellder, Hypno, Drowzee, Misdreavus, Quagsire, and all your most favorite characters! ==Publications== {{publications/h|Johto}} {{publications|cover=Magical Pokémon Journey JP volume 7.png|edition=First|country=Japan|company=Shogakukan|date=February 24, 2001|ISBN=4091358470}} {{publications|cover=Magical Pokémon Journey VIZ volume 7.png|edition=First|country=United States|company=VIZ Media|date=November 6, 2002|ISBN=1569318492}} {{publications|cover=Magical Pokémon Journey CY volume 7.png|edition=First|country=Singapore|company=Chuang Yi|date=November 6, 2002|ISBN=9812399771}} {{publications|cover=Magical Pokémon Journey KO volume 7.png|edition=First|country={{color2|000|Pokémon in South Korea|South Korea}}|company=Haksan Culture Company|date=July 2001|ISBN=9788952914804}} |} ==Chapters== * ''[[PPP37|The Mysterious Beauty]]'' * ''[[PPP38|Swimming with the Qwilfish]]'' * ''[[PPP39|The Very First Date]]'' * ''[[PPP40|Heavenly Pokémon]]'' * ''[[PPP41|Clefairy's Blue Period]]'' * ''[[PPP42|Rock-a-Bye Pokémon (Part 1)]]'' * ''[[PPP43|Rock-a-Bye Pokémon (Part 2)]]'' * ''[[PPPB16|The Hill of the Lone Star Tree]]'' * ''[[PPPB17|Jigglypuff's Joy]]'' ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[VIZ Media]] release, the Pokémon File swaps [[Gramps]] and {{MPJ|Mandy}}'s portraits. {{Project Manga notice}} [[Category:Magical Pokémon Journey volumes|Magical Pokémon Journey volume 07]] [[es:Tomo 7 (Magical Pokémon Journey)]]
